description: The authority withdrawing within balance returns the new balance
A withdraw requested by a non-authority caller is rejected with -1
An over-withdraw that would underflow the balance is rejected with -2
An exact-balance withdraw by the authority returns zero
A caller that sorts BELOW the authority is still not the authority: an ordering comparison passes t2 and fails here, because addresses have no order, only equality
Near-miss in the LAST byte: 31 of 32 bytes match. A gate that compares only the first byte (or any prefix) lets this address drain the vault
Near-miss in the FIRST byte, so the mirror of t6: a gate that compares only the last byte fails here. Only a full 32-byte equality passes both
